So here's the top ones I could come up with:

  1. Minetest. It's the FOSS Minecraft! - well that and all mods are server-side. Yes. All of them. Download ONE client, and use it everywhere. None of this 3rd party launcher crap.
  2. Pioneers. This Catan clone is really nice. Run your own server if you want, add bots. The "greedy" AI is a bit challenging but sort of narrow-minded in its focus.
  3. Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup aka Crawl. A roguelike. A bit easier to pick up than Nethack IMO.
  4. Corsix-TH Engine remake of Theme Hospital. Requires non-free game files.
  5. OpenRA Engine remake of Command & Conquer Red Alert Requires non-free game files.
  6. OpenArena - Deathmatch FPS - Based heavily on Quake III.
  7. FreeCiv - Civilization II clone. Also try their HTML 5 version.
  8. Angband - Roguelike. Lots of variants, too.
  9. MegaZeux - Mid 90's ASCII adventure game w/ its own construction set. Later Freed, still going.
  10. FLARE - Real-time RPG clone, think Diablo.
  11. Battle for Wesnoth - Turn-based RTS. Amazing soundtrack.
  12. Ur-Quan Masters - Freed Engine for Star Control 2 (the 3DO version). Requires non-free game files. Be sure to pick up the remixed soundtrack, some done by the original composers.
  13. Nethack - One of the oldest Roguelikes around. The Dev Team Thinks of Everything.
  14. OpenTTD - Transport Tycoon Deluxe engine remake. Does not seem to require non-Free game files these days; the project is very mature.
